headline: JJ Gabriel, 16, announces exit from Man Utd as Real Madrid deal nears
facts: The 16-year-old posted a farewell video on Instagram about leaving for his 'next chapter'; United say they were not told first and could not reach him or his family.
Real Madrid reportedly agreed a deal earlier in November but plan to sign him in January; he asked to leave United in September.
He has an EU passport through both parents; United say they will challenge the move legally if they find proof of inducement.
He never played a competitive first-team match for United.
background: Gabriel joined United's academy in 2020 at age 10 and made a pre-season first-team debut at 15 against Atletico Madrid.
footage_terms: JJ Gabriel Manchester United academy highlights
JJ Gabriel pre-season debut Atletico Madrid

headline: Estevao struggles for minutes at Chelsea under Xabi Alonso
facts: ESPN says he has played in ten Premier League games this season with only one start, the 2-0 home win over Man Utd in late October.
Alonso's preferred 3-4-3 is described as a poor fit for him, and he was taken off at half-time in the 6-3 Carabao Cup win over Leeds.
For Brazil, Ancelotti has started him in four of five post-World Cup games; he has five international goals.
Alonso has said there are no plans to move him on, but the article raises the idea of an earlier exit.
background: Estevao joined Chelsea from Palmeiras and scored 8 goals in 36 games in his first season before a serious hamstring injury ruled him out of the World Cup.
footage_terms: Xabi Alonso Chelsea press conference Estevao

headline: Arsenal's Max Dowman, 16, becomes youngest England U21 goalscorer
facts: Dowman scored a late tap-in from Harrison Armstrong's pass to give England U21 a 3-2 win over France at Ashton Gate.
England led 2-0, let France equalise, then regained the lead through him.
A linked ESPN headline says he broke Jude Bellingham's record as the youngest England U21 scorer.
background: Dowman is a 16-year-old Arsenal academy prodigy; the record he took was held by Jude Bellingham, now at Real Madrid.
footage_terms: Max Dowman England U21 goal France

headline: Bayern reportedly still chasing Liverpool teen Rio Ngumoha
facts: ESPN, citing Bild's Christian Falk, says Bayern are still in talks to sign the 18-year-old England winger.
Bayern reportedly offered 70 million euros in the summer but signed Ismael Saibari instead.
They still need a left winger and could move in January or next summer.
A later ESPN roundup (Nov 18) says Liverpool reportedly have no plans to sell.
background: Ngumoha is an England international winger who broke into Liverpool's first team as a teenager.

headline: Arsenal, PSG and Bayern reportedly eye Bournemouth's Junior Kroupi
facts: The Mirror, via ESPN, says Arsenal, PSG and Bayern are exploring a January move for the 20-year-old forward.
Bournemouth are reportedly reluctant to sell mid-season; a separate Sun report quoted by ESPN says they want 100 million pounds.
Coach Marco Rose said on Oct 30 that Kroupi is not ready to start and must be patient after a foot injury kept him out for three months.
He returned in a 3-0 win over Man Utd.
background: Kroupi is a 20-year-old forward whose price tag has jumped despite few starts this season.
footage_terms: Marco Rose Bournemouth press conference Kroupi

headline: Arda Guler signs new six-year Real Madrid deal after epic free kick
facts: The 21-year-old's new contract runs to 30 June 2032, announced by the club on a Wednesday.
He scored a spectacular free kick against Belgium for Turkiye, who lost that match.
This LaLiga season he has 12 appearances, 3 goals and 4 assists.
He has 126 Real Madrid appearances, five trophies and 38 Turkiye caps.
background: Guler joined Real Madrid from Fenerbahce in 2023 and has spent four seasons at the club.
footage_terms: Arda Guler free kick Belgium Turkiye
Arda Guler new contract Real Madrid

headline: Alex Scott, 23, becomes the midfield prize for Arsenal, Chelsea and Liverpool
facts: Sky reports the 23-year-old England midfielder has 12 months left on his Bournemouth deal and no new contract is agreed.
Bournemouth reportedly want close to 100 million pounds, though about 75 to 80 million plus bonuses could get a deal done.
Arsenal are willing to sell a midfielder, with Mikel Merino seen as most likely, to fund a move.
Thomas Tuchel has called him 'the complete package'; a recent England-duty injury has sidelined him.
background: Scott is a Bournemouth midfielder now linked with the clubs at the top of the table; Andoni Iraola, his old Bournemouth coach, is now at Liverpool.

headline: Spain coach denies Lamine Yamal got 'special privileges' during knee scare
facts: De la Fuente rejected claims of preferential treatment after Yamal joined camp late with inflammation in his right knee.
Yamal did not travel for the Nations League game against Czechia; the coach said he was upset by what he called 'lying' in reports.
The knee discomfort came after Barcelona's 2-1 win at Atletico Madrid.
The coach expected him back in camp on the Friday.
background: Yamal is 19, a World Cup winner with Spain and one of Barcelona's biggest stars.
footage_terms: Lamine Yamal Spain press conference De la Fuente

headline: Yamal wins the Kopa Trophy at the 2026 Ballon d'Or in London
facts: The 70th ceremony was held on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium, the first time it was outside France or Switzerland.
Harry Kane won the men's Ballon d'Or; Yamal took the Kopa Trophy for the best young player.
Sky Sports previewed Yamal with 25 goals and 20 assists in 2025/26 and the most dribbles at the World Cup (58).
Sky also said he was aiming to become the youngest ever Ballon d'Or winner.
background: Yamal won LaLiga and the Super Cup with Barcelona and helped Spain win the World Cup, scoring once in the tournament.

headline: Barcelona's Pau Cubarsi crowned 2026 Golden Boy
facts: Cubarsi, 19, won the award for the best under-21 player, succeeding PSG's Desire Doue.
He is the fourth Barcelona player to win it in six years, after Pedri, Gavi and Yamal.
He is the first defender to win since Matthijs de Ligt in 2018.
Tuttosport draws up 100 nominees and journalists from 22 European countries vote.
background: Wikipedia lists Cubarsi as the 2026 World Cup Best Young Player with Spain, who beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final.

headline: Rennes 14-year-old Thymeo Hanyurwimana Ferreira Cruz is compared to Messi
facts: Born 5 April 2012, the attacking midfielder trains with Rennes U19s and plays for the U17s.
Rennes signed him to a semi-professional deal starting 1 July 2027; a pro contract the next day would make him the youngest Ligue 1 player at just over 15.
Goal reports interest from Barcelona and Manchester City, but he and his entourage reportedly prefer Rennes.
He signed with Adidas very young, and Goal says the Messi comparisons include the shared kit sponsor.
background: Rennes' academy has produced Ousmane Dembele, Eduardo Camavinga and Desire Doue.

headline: Barcelona extend La Masia product Xavi Espart to 2030
facts: Barcelona renewed the academy product until 30 June 2030; he signed in Joan Laporta's office at Spotify Camp Nou.
He can play full-back on either flank or in midfield and has mostly played on the left, competing with Joao Cancelo.
Before an ankle injury he had 9 matches, 2 goals and 2 assists; he hurt his right ankle in the Clasico.
background: Espart has been in Barcelona's academy since 2015; Hansi Flick trusts him as a versatile option.

headline: Freiburg's Derry Scherhant, 24, blossoms under Klopp and draws Roma and Bayern
facts: Goal says he joined Freiburg in 2025 for about 2 million euros and has 3 goals and 8 assists in all competitions this season.
He scored his first Germany goal in a 5-0 win over the Netherlands, in his fourth call-up; Klopp gave him his debut against Serbia.
Roma have scouted him and are frustrated that his price is expected to rise at least tenfold.
Another Goal report says Bayern have him on a left-wing list, per tz.
background: Born in Berlin in 2002, he came through several Berlin youth sides and developed late; Jurgen Klopp is now Germany head coach.
footage_terms: Klopp Germany Scherhant Gruda press conference

headline: Real Madrid and Barcelona fight for Brighton centre-back Luka Vuskovic, 'the new Rodri'
facts: Goal, citing El Desmarque, says the 19-year-old Croatia centre-back is wanted by both Spanish giants.
Barcelona reportedly tried to sign him; Real Madrid are taking a less direct route.
Brighton are expected to listen to offers at the end of the season and could demand a huge sum.
His Brighton contract runs to June 2031.
background: Vuskovic is a Croatia international centre-back at Brighton, whose contract runs to June 2031.

headline: Leipzig loanee Brajan Gruda reportedly worth 100 million euros to Leipzig
facts: Per Bild, Leipzig would only sell for 'completely outrageous' offers of around 100 million euros.
Leipzig's 25 million euro obligation to buy him from Brighton reportedly triggers after three Bundesliga games, possibly by mid-January 2027.
He has 2 goals and 5 assists in his last eight competitive matches and 2 Germany caps, including a goal against Serbia.
Sport Bild reported Bayern's interest; Leipzig coach Martin Demichelis told him to stay grounded.
background: Leipzig borrowed him from Brighton in early February 2026 for a 1 million euro loan fee; his contract runs to 2031.

headline: Monza striker Gustavo Varela leads Serie A scoring and has Europe calling
facts: He leads Serie A with 9 league goals and 11 in all competitions, yet Monza are in the relegation zone.
He earned his first senior Portugal call-up in November 2026.
Tottenham have made an enquiry, Liverpool are watching weekly, and Juventus and Napoli want a January deal.
Goal.com reports an asking price of 35 million euros (Goal's figure, not confirmed by Football Italia).
background: A year earlier he was a 20-year-old on loan at Gil Vicente in Portugal.

headline: Club Brugge's Nicolo Tresoldi goes level with Haaland on five Champions League goals
facts: After matchday 4 of 2026/27, Como's Tasos Douvikas led with 6 goals; Haaland and Tresoldi had 5 each.
Kylian Mbappe, Harry Kane and Raphinha were among the players on 4.
ESPN (Nov 11) says AC Milan are pursuing the 22-year-old; Football Italia calls him Milan's preferred option for January.
background: Tresoldi is a 22-year-old Club Brugge striker now chased by AC Milan.
footage_terms: Nicolo Tresoldi Club Brugge Champions League goals

headline: Leipzig winger Antonio Nusa, 21, is Bundesliga's newest star and an Arsenal target
facts: Sky Sports published a best-of video of Nusa's Bundesliga season on 20 November 2026.
A Sky article (Nov 17) says he has 14 goal contributions in 15 games this season.
Arsenal are monitoring him, but Leipzig reportedly will not sell in January, so a summer move looks likelier.
background: Nusa is a 21-year-old Norway winger who plays for RB Leipzig.

headline: Gladbach's 17-year-old Wael Mohya draws Liverpool and Bayern, but Klopp leaves him out
facts: ESPN, citing Bild, says the 17-year-old attacking midfielder has 2 goals and 1 assist in 9 Bundesliga games.
Liverpool and Bayern are reportedly interested, with Brighton, Leverkusen and Leipzig linked earlier.
Klopp left him out of Germany's 23-man squad for the Nations League game in Serbia (ESPN, Nov 12).
background: Mohya plays as a No. 10 for Gladbach and is among Germany's youngest rising names.

headline: Jobe Bellingham gets first England call-up and could join Jude in the squad
facts: The 21-year-old Dortmund midfielder was called up by Thomas Tuchel for the first time after strong form for England U21 and Dortmund.
He could feature against Croatia and Spain, making the Bellinghams the 22nd set of brothers to play for England.
He said playing with Jude would be a huge bonus and that he was thrilled when Tuchel phoned him.
background: Jobe is the younger brother of Real Madrid's Jude Bellingham and plays for Dortmund.

headline: Bosnian teen Kerim Alajbegovic scores first Serie A goal as Juventus beat Napoli
facts: Juventus beat 10-man Napoli 2-0 at the Allianz Stadium on 1 November 2026.
The Bosnian teenager scored the opener in the 70th minute with a 20-yard shot into the top corner, his first Serie A goal.
Jeremie Boga added the second.
background: Alajbegovic is a Bosnian teenager in Juventus's squad; ESPN does not give his exact age.

headline: Dortmund's Samuele Inacio, 18, out for months with knee injury
facts: Dortmund confirmed on 20 November that the 18-year-old has a meniscus injury needing surgery, out for 'several months'.
He was hurt in Italy U21's 2-2 friendly draw with Belgium and replaced by Seydou Fini.
He won his first senior cap in June; Mancini included him in squads but he was left out in November.
background: Inacio is an Italy talent at Dortmund who earned his first senior cap under interim coach Silvio Baldini.

headline: Milan plan January loans for Francesco Camarda and Christian Comotto
facts: Football Italia says Milan expect to loan out both young players in January.
Genoa are the most advanced in talks for Comotto; Camarda has 'numerous proposals' from Serie A, Serie B and abroad.
Goal.com adds that Monza could use Camarda as an option if Varela leaves, and that Ibrahimovic blocked his move to Monza two years ago.
The same report says Milan may sell Estupinan and Loftus-Cheek.
background: Camarda is a Milan academy forward who has not been a regular first-team starter; Milan now plan to loan him out.

headline: Dietmar Hamann says 'sky's the limit' for Bayern teen Lennart Karl
facts: Goal says the 18-year-old right winger is tied to Bayern through summer 2029.
Hamann called him probably Germany's biggest young prospect and said his Golden Boy chances may depend on Olise's situation.
A thigh injury ruled him out of the 2026 World Cup and he had a slow start to this season.
He competes with Olise, Luis Diaz and Harry Kane.
background: Karl became Bayern's youngest Champions League scorer at 17 years and 242 days after debuting at the 2025 Club World Cup.

headline: Real Madrid's Yan Diomande hits a stunning half-volley in 3-0 win at Racing
facts: Sky Sports says Diomande scored a sensational half-volley in Real Madrid's 3-0 LaLiga win at Racing Santander's El Sardinero.
The strike silenced the home crowd and left team-mates stunned.
ESPN lists him in a debate with Vinicius Junior over a start against Celta Vigo.
background: Diomande is a Real Madrid forward whose age Sky does not state; he now competes with Vinicius Junior for a spot.
footage_terms: Yan Diomande half volley Real Madrid

headline: Veron says Como's Nico Paz does things he has only seen Messi and Maradona do
facts: In a Gazzetta dello Sport interview, Veron said that at 22 Paz does things he has only seen Messi and Maradona do, though he did not say Paz would reach their level.
Paz has 6 goals and 8 assists in 14 Como games this season and 5 goals in 5 games for Argentina.
Veron warned that comparisons with legends have hurt many young Argentine No. 10s.
He said Paz and Franco Mastantuono could be Argentina's future playmakers.
background: Paz scored 12 goals with 7 assists for Como last season.
footage_terms: Veron interview Nico Paz Messi Maradona

headline: Racing Santander loanee Yassir Zabiri, 21, has scored half his club's league goals
facts: ESPN says the 21-year-old has 9 goals in 12 La Liga games and more than half of Racing's 17 league goals.
He is on loan from Rennes with no purchase option; he previously played for Famalicao.
ESPN puts his expected goals at about 0.72 per 90 minutes, similar to Paris FC's Lassine Sinayoko, 26.
background: Zabiri is a Rennes-owned forward who was not a household name before this season.

headline: Chelsea's Valentin Barco says he can give 'a lot more' despite limited minutes
facts: The 22-year-old said he believes he has much more to offer and wants to earn playing time at Chelsea.
He has had limited minutes under Xabi Alonso and has struggled to become a regular since joining Chelsea last summer.
He was in Argentina's World Cup squad that finished runners-up to Spain but missed the recent friendlies against Uruguay and Costa Rica.
background: Barco is signed through 2033 after strong performances at Strasbourg; he made only seven appearances at Brighton.

headline: Man City teen Floyd Samba scores twice on debut, compared to Pogba
facts: ESPN says the 17-year-old scored two goals on his senior debut in a 5-0 Carabao Cup win over Norwich, with Enzo Maresca playing him as a striker.
He is about 6 feet tall, a free-kick specialist, and models his game on Paul Pogba as a box-to-box No. 8.
He scored a notable free kick against Man United in last season's FA Youth Cup final.
This is background older than 45 days.
background: City lack a natural backup for Erling Haaland, which could open striker minutes for him.
footage_terms: Floyd Samba Manchester City debut goals
Floyd Samba free kick FA Youth Cup final
